We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic molecule given only task description? No data provided. We need to use tools to get spectra etc. The sample is at hand; we can call mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, maybe retrieve shifts. We need to deduce structure.

We should start by measuring mass spectrum to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
